headline: California Lutheran sets the SCIAC pace
dek: California Lutheran has won eighteen matches across all competitions, drawing three and losing two while scoring 59 goals and conceding fourteen. Pomona-Pitzer sits just behind at the top of the table, with the rest of the conference well off the pace. Only Azusa Pacific still has matches left on the schedule.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring across the SCIAC is sharply top-heavy: California Lutheran has 59 goals in all matches, more than Chapman, Whittier, Redlands, and Caltech combined.

wire.line: Caltech has lost fourteen matches with zero wins, scoring two goals and conceding 57.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Pomona-Pitzer has conceded just seven goals while scoring 42 across fourteen wins, one draw, and three losses.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: California Lutheran midfielder Sawyer Frye has recorded nine goals and nine assists on 35 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Redlands goalkeeper Nicole Immoos has made 162 saves with a 0.786 save percentage while conceding 44 goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ten August matches involving Redlands, Chapman, California Lutheran, La Verne, and Whittier remain past their dates with no published result.

last_match.line: The loss snapped California Lutheran's unbeaten run that had stretched since September.

next_match.line: Azusa Pacific is the only SCIAC program still playing, returning from a win at Redlands.
